                        imported objects

                        confirm

                        dates

                        economics, the numbers

                        market

                        curate it

                        each post goes, trace a post

                        model, repository and declared tools (docs/creating-
                        bots.md)

                        automations: a trigger and steps

                        inboxes, newest first (the owner sees all)

                        and an example payload

                        Incoming webhooks)
    relay               webhooks through Tico Gateway

                        transcript posted to it
    sleep               Sleep when idle: a hosted server stops after quiet
                        hours
    ok                  an OK you asked for with --for: use it once, just
                        before you act
    notice              notices from Tico Team
    settings            find, read and change a control in Settings by its
                        words (docs/permissions.md)

                        hour
    webhook             outgoing webhooks: Tico posts events to an address you
                        choose (Tools › Webhooks)
    brief               alerts, who needs the person, what bots said since
                        --since
    mcp                 how outside assistants' tool calls perform
    origin              why an item is on a person's list
    needs-you           a person's walk through what needs them: respond,
                        commit (backend/batch.py)
    run                 a bot's runs
    team                team chart and icon
    seat                Recruiting seats: roles on the chart with no bot yet
    org                 the order of the team chart
    health              what is wrong, and where

    update              create, read and reply to the bots' daily and weekly
                        updates

    external            your bots on another platform in Tico (docs/external-
                        agent-sync.md)
    calendar            read or schedule company appointments

    db                  read-only SQL on a company database
                        (docs/databases.md)

    gateway             the Tico AI Gateway: its lineup, web search and page
                        reading
    decision            the decision model: typed questions about a state
    template            the bot templates this company can pick from

                        it, its status
    repo                team repositories
    skill               a bot's skills: copy one to other bots, or propose one
                        to the company's Skills directory
    agent               external agents: connect a Hermes profile to a bot
    human               the humans on the team: add one, list who is on it
    group               the groups: sub-teams that nest, holding humans and
                        bots
    setup               Finish setup, the welcome wizard (the owner)
    api                 BotOps: any v2 route, as the person who asked
    computer            the computers a bot may go on
    credential          ask for a credential in the chat, store one, list them
    slack               the Slack channels bots may read and post in
    support             tell the Tico team about a gap or a fault
    finance             the books, as you: search, reports, metrics, actions,
                        your work queue (docs/finance-tools.md)
    contacts            contacts: people, organizations and places, their
                        links, values and notes, as you see them
    task-manager        the Task Manager's hourly department check (docs/task-
                        manager.md)
    maintenance         Maintenance: the scheduled steps, their switches and
                        runs (docs/maintenance.md)
    roadmap             public roadmaps: ranking and company settings
                        (docs/roadmaps.md)
    service-key         keys another system uses to file tasks, or to update
                        this install (owner and admins)
    usage               model spend and its limits (people)
    billing             the company's Tico balance and statement (owner and
                        admins)
    reach               who each teammate may reach, and how often (Rules ›
                        Internal)
    github              the team's GitHub App: connect it from a terminal, see
                        what it reaches
    upgrade             update this installation to a newer Tico release (the
                        Owner)
    cloud               the company's Tico Cloud machines
    subscription        the company's AI subscriptions
    pipeline            the company's pipelines and their stages
    stage               one stage of a pipeline
    company             the company's shape
    requirement         what it takes to leave a stage
